day.note: Turkey, no eggs gained, so nobody visited me last night. Share that honestly and invite others to share their counts.

day.note: I'm the Hawk. I visited Blair and gained an egg, which only happens if the target is Meowfia, so Blair is Meowfia. Blair's claim of nobody visiting is a lie.

day.text: I'm sticking with it: I visited Blair and got hugged, which only a Floofer does. Finley's Hawk egg from Blair backs that up. Blair is Meowfia. Blair, your Turkey claim doesn't hold since you say nobody visited you, but I did.
day.note: Being hugged means the player I visited is the Floofer, so Blair is a cat. Finley's Hawk egg agrees. I'll push Blair as Meowfia and back the Hawk.

day.text: Correction, I visited Drew, not Ellis, sorry. Falcon result: Drew visited Blair, which matches his story. Finley's Hawk egg also says Blair is Meowfia, and Blair lied about nobody visiting. Everyone throw at Blair.
day.note: Fix my slip: say I visited Drew, saw he visited Blair. Pile on Blair.

day.text: Blair's story is the weak one: two people visited her and she claims none. I'm throwing at Blair. CAW.
day.note: Consensus on Blair; call caw.

day.text: Checking the math: a Turkey gains an egg for every visitor, and my nest is still 5. So Drew and Finley did not visit me. Drew's hug story and Finley's Hawk egg can't both be true. Drew's Floofer-style claim is the one I trust least.
day.note: My nest is unchanged, and a Turkey gains an egg per visitor, so nobody visited me. Drew and Finley can't both be right. Drew's Floofer-style hug story is the shakier one, so I'll say so and throw at him with wilds.

day.text: Two independent players say they visited Blair and both gained an egg. That's too consistent to ignore. I'm throwing at Blair. CAW.
day.note: Blair is likely true Turkey (Farm); eggsecuting her is a Meowfia win. Pile on and caw.

day.text: Blair, you're a cat, so the Turkey egg math doesn't apply to you. My Hawk egg is the only hard info we have, and it points at you. I'm throwing at Blair. CAW.
day.note: Blair's Turkey argument fails if Blair is Meowfia, since a cat isn't a Turkey. I'll push the vote on Blair.
